droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `network_loss` (network_loss): Drop the network, then trigger the screen's submit or slow action; the app must not crash or go silent.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"fault": "network_off"}, {"tap": "place_order"}, {"settle": 5.3}]
Result: crashed: java.io.IOException: Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network
Crash: java.io.IOException @ com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository.submit(OrderRepository.kt:27)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel$placeOrder$1.invokeSuspend(CheckoutViewModel.kt:32)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder(CheckoutViewModel.kt:31)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt.CheckoutScreen$lambda$20$lambda$18$lambda$17(CheckoutScreen.kt:77)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.CheckoutScreenKt$$ExternalSyntheticLambda9.invoke(D8$$SyntheticClass:0)

## Diagnosis
Root cause: OrderRepository.submit throws IOException when there is no network (OrderRepository.kt:27). CheckoutViewModel.placeOrder launches that call in viewModelScope with no try/catch (CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-34), so the exception escapes the coroutine and crashes the app. Even if it were caught, `placing = true` is only reset on the success path (line 33), so the spinner would stay on forever. The design flaw is that the ViewModel treats a recoverable network failure as an unrecoverable exception and has no error state for the UI to show.
Fix approach: In placeOrder, wrap the submit call in try/catch(IOException) inside the coroutine. On failure, reset `placing` to false and set an observable `error` state (for example 'No network, try again'). Show that error in CheckoutScreen and keep the form contents so the user can retry the button. To make this testable, put OrderRepository behind a small interface (or pass a suspend lambda) so the ViewModel can be tested with a fake that throws.
Evidence: app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:27 - submit() throws IOException when isOnline() is false, which is the crash site; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/data/OrderRepository.kt:32-35 - isOnline() reads the active network capability, so offline always returns false; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:30 - placing is set to true before the launch; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:31-34 - viewModelScope.launch calls orders.submit with no try/catch, so the IOException is uncaught; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt:33 - placing=false runs only after a successful submit, so a failure would leave the spinner stuck; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:77 - the Place order onClick calls vm.placeOrder, which is the entry point in the crash stack; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt:78-81 - the button is disabled while placing and shows a spinner, and no error is rendered anywhere

## Files to change
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutViewModel.kt
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/CheckoutScreen.kt

## Regression test
Add a JVM unit test in src/test, CheckoutViewModelTest, that gives the ViewModel a fake order source whose submit throws java.io.IOException, fills all fields, and calls placeOrder. It asserts that the coroutine does not throw, that `placing` returns to false, that `orderId` stays null, and that `error` is non-null. Before the fix the test fails because the exception propagates out of viewModelScope and `placing` stays true. After the fix it passes.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- Before you finish, call the compile tool on your test ('unit' or 'instrumented') and fix every error it reports.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )
}

12	    val name: String,
13	    val email: String,
14	    val phone: String,

20	/** Talks to the (fake) orders backend. Needs a working network connection, like the real one. */
21	class OrderRepository(context: Context) {
22	
23	    private val connectivity = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(ConnectivityManager::class.java)
24	
25	    /** Places the order and returns its id. */
26	    suspend fun submit(order: OrderRequest): String {
27	        if (!isOnline()) throw IOException("Unable to reach orders.monkeymart.example: no network")
28	        delay(1_500)
29	        return "MM-%06d".format(Random.nextInt(1_000_000))
30	    }
31

package com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding

import androidx.compose.foundation.text.KeyboardOptions
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.Card
import androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.KeyboardType
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.viewmodel.compose.viewModel
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.OrderRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.ProductRepository
import com.shubhasai.monkeymart.data.priceLabel

@Composable
fun CheckoutScreen(
    productId: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    vm: CheckoutViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val product = ProductRepository.cached(productId)
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val orders = remember { OrderRepository(context) }

    val placedId = vm.orderId
    if (placedId != null) {
        Column(modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp).testTag("order_confirmed"), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            Text("Order placed 🎉", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall)
            Text("Order $placedId is on its way to ${vm.city}.", modifier = Modifier.testTag("order_id"))
        }
        return
    }

    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(16.dp)
            .testTag("checkout_screen"),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
    ) {
        if (product != null) {
            Card(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Row(Modifier.padding(16.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    Text("${product.emoji} ${product.name}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f))
                    Text(product.priceLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium, modifier = Modifier.testTag("checkout_total"))
                }
            }
        }

        Text("Delivery details", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
        CheckoutField("Full name", vm.name, { vm.name = it }, "field_name")
        CheckoutField("Email", vm.email, { vm.email = it }, "field_email", KeyboardType.Email)
        CheckoutField("Phone", vm.phone, { vm.phone = it }, "field_phone", KeyboardType.Phone)
        CheckoutField("Address", vm.address, { vm.address = it }, "field_address")
        CheckoutField("City", vm.city, { vm.city = it }, "field_city")
        CheckoutField("Pincode", vm.pincode, { vm.pincode = it }, "field_pincode", KeyboardType.Number)

        ScanCouponButton()

        Button(
            onClick = { vm.placeOrder(orders, productId) },
            enabled = vm.isComplete && !vm.placing,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("place_order"),
        ) {
            if (vm.placing) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.testTag("placing_order")) else Text("Place order")
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CheckoutField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    onChange: (String) -> Unit,
    tag: String,
    keyboard: KeyboardType = KeyboardType.Text,
) {
    OutlinedTextField(
        value = value,
        onValueChange = onChange,
        label = { Text(label) },
        singleLine = true,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = keyboard),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag(tag),
    )
}

        assertNotNull(vm.error)
